title: Stable Algorithms Lower Bounds for Estimation
summary: In this work, we show that for all statistical estimation problems, a natural MMSE instability (discontinuity) condition implies the failure of stable algorithms, serving as a version of OGP for estimation tasks. Using this criterion, we establish separations between stable and polynomial-time algorithms for the following MMSE-unstable tasks (i) Planted Shortest Path, where Dijkstra's algorithm succeeds, (ii) random Parity Codes, where Gaussian elimination succeeds, and (iii) Gaussian Subset Sum, where lattice-based methods succeed.
